violated_contract: A privacy-safe Sentry event that redacts the free-form message must still distinguish which compile-time call site produced the failure. Bucketing only by file-derived area plus NSError domain family collapses unrelated onboarding failures into one [area/underlying_error/runtime] group with error_type=other, so a burst cannot be triaged.
canonical_prevention: Attach a bounded error_site token derived from #fileID last component plus #function, stripped to [a-z0-9], and include it in the onboarding event title and as an error_site tag. Map app-module Swift error types to a bounded type token instead of other. Never send the message, path, or user content. RETIRED 2026-10: the Sentry client integration was removed entirely (crash/error capture no longer exists on any surface), so the class cannot recur; the former guard artifacts (DesktopErrorTelemetryDescriptor, DesktopErrorTelemetryTests) were deleted with the subsystem.
